titulo.estudio: Une étiquette de produit : Repérer les informations

intro: Interpret quantities, prices and basic data on a label. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Interpret quantities, prices and basic data on a label. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: units such as « g », « kg » and « ml » complete the product name; « par » expresses the unit price. In this passage, «étiquette» means «label».

frases.estudio: Sur l'étiquette, ce paquet de farine pèse un kilo.
frases.alumno: On the label, this bag of flour weighs one kilo.

frases.estudio: Le prix est de deux euros cinquante par paquet.
frases.alumno: The price is two euros fifty per package.
